dogecoin.text: @DavidJLittlexD @dogecoin Hello, we are constantly evaluating it, but it's not that simple, payment thresholds allow us to keep up with the blockchain tx fees, having too many small payouts would force us to increase our fees or charge tx fees to miners, which isn't really an option for small miners 😞
Big shout-out to all $DOGE @dogecoin (un)miners out there! 🔥
